notes.title: Review By Deaf Sparrow And A Chance To Win A Free Copy
notes.content:
[h1]Happy new year![/h1]

Still waiting to get your hands on Kontrakt? or still undecided? If so, maybe a review by Deaf Sparrow will help. Major press won't cover what might be considered too underground. So, how about something too underground for cult?

[i]"As an indie title Kontrakt offers what it needs to: extreme violence with no care what society thinks, a great soundtrack made from acid-laced snorted gunpowder, a twist on mental illness and the core concept that would never pass a censorship board, and extreme challenge for the true hitman in you."[/i]

[url=https://www.deafsparrow.com/2018/12/25/kontrakt-schizophrenic-hitman-adrenaline-slaughter/]Review by Deaf Sparrow (4.3 / 5)[/url]
